tools.name: search_gyms
tools.description: Find gyms and studios (CrossFit, HYROX, fitness, yoga, pilates, boxing, martial arts, dance) in France and Europe, near a point or by name, city or postcode. Gymmy gyms (onGymmy: true) can be booked; others are listed from OpenStreetMap, not bookable, with a claim link. Use the `gym` value with get_

tools.name: get_gym
tools.description: Details of a Gymmy gym: description, address, opening hours, sites, how to book, page and join links.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming classes of a Gymmy gym (next 14 days): time, duration, spots left, and a booking link with the class already picked.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Memberships, class packs and trial offers of a Gymmy gym with prices in EUR and a direct sign-up link per offer.

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Gives the link to book a trial class at a Gymmy gym, with the trial offer and optionally the class already picked. The person opens it and confirms with their name and email; nothing is booked or charged by this tool.

tools.name: my_gyms
tools.description: Gyms the signed-in Gymmy member belongs to.

tools.name: my_bookings
tools.description: The signed-in member's upcoming booked and waitlisted classes (next 2 weeks) at one of their Gymmy gyms.

tools.name: my_schedule
tools.description: Classes at the signed-in member's gym for a week, with the class ids book_class needs, spots left and whether they are booked.

tools.name: book_class
tools.description: Books a class for the signed-in member with their own membership (or puts them on the waitlist when full, if the gym allows). Uses the gym's booking rules. No payment is taken here.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels the signed-in member's booking (or waitlist spot) for a class. The gym's cancellation deadline applies; a late cancel may count as used.
